text:
Asha Rao: starting OrbitEdge POC perf sync. customer goal = sustained 280 qps for short chat turns, occasional 1k-token context threads. target p95 <220ms, prefer lower cost quant if quality holds. need plan for fp16, ptq-int8, awq-int8 + embedding background load.
Ben Torres: can run on dedicated us-east1 pool. request: 1k-session corpus with 8% embed-only calls and 12% long-context sessions. shall we enable prefix caching?
Asha Rao: yes enable prefix caching. use anonymized product-support corpus; i'll post link. customer also wants cold-start profile and a warm-run.
Vera Liu: testing plan: 4m ramp, 18m steady @280 qps, 6m soak at peak, capture p50/p95/p99, cold tails, KV-hit, GPU mem, and token throughput. will run each quant twice (cold + warm).
ci-bot: provision started: cluster/dedicated/us-east1/slotset-21 image=redwood-runtime:2026-03-12-rc1 status=allocating.
Marco Silva: infra note: recommend 8 active slots + 1 spare for headroom. if multi-az requested we need ops signoff and SLA addendum.
Ben Torres: pre-run estimates: fp16 p95 ~205-220ms, ptq-int8 p95 ~230-260ms depending on jitter, awq-int8 p95 ~180-200ms but watch p99 on cold. GPU util estimates: fp16 ~64%, ptq ~48%, awq ~38%. cost ballpark: ptq ~0.6x, awq ~0.5x vs fp16.
Asha Rao: include cost per 1M tokens and a short quality eval (50-case) in the report. flag any >5% accuracy drop or hallucination increase.
Vera Liu: running fp16 baseline now. command: 
```
loadtest --corpus s3://redwood-poc/orbitedge/1k.json --target 280 --ramp 4m --steady 18m --model redwood/v1.2 --quant fp16 --cache-prefix --output /artifacts/orbitedge/1759102468/fp16.csv
```
ci-bot: run complete -> /artifacts/orbitedge/1759102468/fp16.csv status=success
Vera Liu: fp16 smoke: p95=198ms, p99=410ms (cold tails), kv hit=70%, GPU util avg=62%. exporting CSV.
Ben Torres: ptq sweep starting.
ci-bot: run complete -> /artifacts/orbitedge/1759102468/ptq.csv status=success
Vera Liu: ptq results: p95=233ms, p99=540ms, jitter visible on steady-state. kv hit=66%, GPU util=47%. noticed slight slowdown on embed-heavy slices.
Ben Torres: awq sweep complete -> /artifacts/orbitedge/1759102468/awq.csv
Vera Liu: awq summary: p95=185ms, p99=480ms with occasional spikes to 700ms on first decode of long contexts. kv hit=73%, GPU util=39%. eval (50-case): 3 cases >5% accuracy drop, hallucination +1.4%.
Marco Silva: ops: keep headroom at 10% in the report. if customer wants cross-region failover, estimate 2x infra and discuss egress cost.
Asha Rao: please assemble a PDF by EOD with: 1-page summary, heatmaps, CSV attachments, cost table per 1M tokens for each quant, eval diff, and a security snippet mentioning customer-managed KMS option for Private/Dedicated.
Vera Liu: attaching artifacts now: /artifacts/orbitedge/1759102468/{fp16.csv,ptq.csv,awq.csv,eval_diff.csv}. will include run commands and raw metrics.
Ben Torres: quick note on quality: recommend canary to fp16 for sessions >800 tokens if customer is sensitive to hallucinations.
Asha Rao: perfect. i'll push the PDF and propose awq-int8 + prefix caching + canary rule. thanks team :thumbsup:
